He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him - but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all - no Teddy!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry (2)
programme.desc: Tom & Jerry take their chase to the skies. Kite-flying has never been this intense. Who will emerge as the ultimate master of strings?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (47)
programme.desc: Grizzy gleefully discovers that he can print images taken with the ranger's camera which is connected to a state-of-the-art printer. He decides to immortalize and frame himself, but when the time comes to print his portrait, there's no more paper in the printer. The Lemmings have thrown themselves heart and soul into the regressive pleasure of paper airplanes.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (48)
programme.desc: A van pulls up to the ranger's cabin to deliver a full crate of jars of chocolate spread. While Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a wrecking bar to open it, someone steals the crate. Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to carry out an investigation to find the trail of their treasure.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (49)
programme.desc: Like usual, Grizzy picks the door of the Ranger's log cabin to come in and make himself comfortable, but this time it's impossible to enter! The Lemmings have requisitioned the cabin for a party and barricaded themselves inside. Grizzy has no intention of waiting for an invitation to find a way to get in.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (50)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have got their hands on a pack of white beans which have very strange properties: when mixed with soda, anyone who eats them turns into a bouncing ball. Grizzy realizes that if he wants to take a nap, he must first get rid of the magic beans.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (51)
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to get rid of the old piano in the garage at any cost, for the Lemmings love using it to make a dissonant racket. But when he happens to notice that the she-bear he's in love with likes the melody of "Für Elise" he decides to learn the learn the piece like a real pro.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (52)
programme.desc: The Lemmings inherit a crate that fell off a Canadian army convoy transporting ultra-secret material. The case inside the crate emits a sort of laser beam that divides objects into multiple miniaturized versions of themselves. What if the Lemmings had to deal with lots of mini-Grizzys rather than just one big one?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (53)
programme.desc: Near the supermarket, a machine hands out surprise eggs in exchange for a coin. Amongst the lots to be won, there is a super firework rocket that makes the Lemmings dream, and a piece of costume jewelry that Grizzy imagines himself giving to his lady-love.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (54)
programme.desc: At the Ranger's home, Grizzy finds a high-tech gadget that enables you to learn anything at all sewing, origami, Kung Fu, etc... within only seconds thank to electrodes hooked to the brain. He can now become the perfect bear! But first, he first needs a program to learn how to get rid of the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (55)
programme.desc: An old metal box found by chance in a recess of a cliff brings back childhood memories for Grizzy and the Lemmings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (56)
programme.desc: How can one peacefully watch a documentary on salmon fish, nice and comfy on the sofa, when the Lemmings are playing chemistry novices with a fun experiment box? By confiscating their equipment? Beware of side effects.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (57)
programme.desc: Grizzy's TV remote control is stolen by a partridge who collects high-tech objects in his nest perched high up in a tree. This is a case of absolute urgency! Grizzy has no other choice but to requisition the Lemmings propulsion game to recover his possession. But try and make a Lemming understand that!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (58)
programme.desc: Grizzy has got it into his head to offer a butterfly to the she-bear he's in love with. But the Lemmings fight with him over the rare specimens he's spotted, for they want to play helicopter. The butterfly hunt is on!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (59)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have discovered an addictive new game based on the astonishing bouncing properties of the ranger's new running shoes. Grizzy, who is trying to relax, confiscates the shoes and soon realizes they are far more comfortable than his thongs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (60)
programme.desc: Grizzy babysits for the she-bear he has a crush on, who has entrusted him with the care of her cub. There's no question of Grizzy tripping up, for he has no intention of taking any risks! But he hadn't reckoned on the Lemmings. Captivated by the baby's burps after meals, they dream of making it drink gallons of soda pop to make it do the "Big One."

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (61)
programme.desc: Unwilling to share the food both he and the Lemmings are wild about, Grizzy locks it up inside the ranger’s brand new and apparently burglar proof safe. He watches the Lemmings’ vain attempts to open the safe with amusement, until he realizes that the string around his neck with the key is far from indestructible.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (44)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (45)
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (46)
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden - a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (47)
programme.desc: Jealous of Mr Paliwal’s new egg-laying chicken, Mr Bean heads off to the local farm to get himself one. But after causing havoc at the coop, he comes home with the wrong chicken - not only will it not lay eggs, but it turns out Mrs Wicket is allergic to feathers so Mr Bean has to keep the chicken well hidden!

programme.title: Lamput (41)
programme.desc: The Docs prove their inventing skills by coming up with an age-altering time-ray. This breakthrough could change the world. If they used it for something other than chasing Lamput. Obsessed much, fellas? Wildly shooting their time-ray off in public causes a not-unsurprising amount of chaos, until the local law enforcement gets caught in the cross-fire. Looks like the Specs and Skinny are gonna be in jail till they get old the normal way.

programme.title: Moley (25)
programme.desc: When Manny’s missing page is replaced with the wrong kind of page, it leads to chaos in Mole Town! Moley must do whatever it takes to replace the page and rescue Manny.

programme.title: Moley (26)
programme.desc: When Manny’s missing page is replaced with the wrong kind of page, it leads to chaos in Mole Town! Moley must do whatever it takes to replace the page and rescue Manny.

programme.title: Moley (27)
programme.desc: It’s the annual MoleTown Races, and each of the residents have their own unique car to compete for the grand prize. But how will Moley cope when he finds out there are no rules?

programme.title: Moley (28)
programme.desc: Dotty discovers that Mystic has found a lost treasure map from the great above, and persuades Moley and Manny to help in the search.

programme.title: Moley (29)
programme.desc: MoleTown is becoming lazy and so Dotty helps Moley exercise, giving the Gardener an idea, he sets up a Golf Course to trap Manny, but things don’t go to plan.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time (13)
programme.desc: The crew plays Hide N’ Seek at headquarters and Tweety is the seeker.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (40)
programme.desc: Everyone realizes that they don’t actually know what Fung and Miff’s special gifts are! So Puff and our Mushlers set out to try and find out without Fung and Miff knowing.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (41)
programme.desc: Chep has created a cloak out of a leaf and Chanterelle thinks it’s super fashionable. But when she makes a similar cloak to Chep’s, a fashion rivalry is born!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (42)
programme.desc: To finally bring life-long friends Mushpot and Starmush back together, Truff goes to help Starmush succeed at an impossible challenge set by Musho…

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (43)
programme.desc: When Mushpie gets sick, our Mushlers find it impossible to believe that she turns into the most demanding Mushable ever. Well, they’re about to find out that it’s all true!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (44)
programme.desc: Fung finds out that to earn a delicious treat from Sushi-Mushi you just need to look after the Food Snail for him. No problem! Actually, it becomes a huge problem for Fung!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (6)
programme.desc: During training at the Hero Base, the SuperThings mistake Kid Fury for a villain because of his yellow eyes.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (61)
programme.desc: As Jerry and Tuffy play marbles, Tom throws a soccer ball in their direction and upsets the game. This sparks a chase between Tom and Jerry, and Jerry takes cover in a room that looks like a giant chessboard. As more chess pieces show up, Tom and Jerry attempt their best to outplay them.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (62)
programme.desc: After catching a crook, Tom and Jerry are framed, and the police chase them instead of the true criminal. Tom and Jerry must go on the lam as they try to avoid jail time.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (63)
programme.desc: Because of an injured foot, Rick stays home with Ginger's mother, Rosemary, taking care of him. Rosemary brings her infamous fat-free-dairy-free whole wheat gravy, and she quickly puts Rick, Spike and Tom on nutritious diets. Antics and fights break out as Rick and the pets crave real food.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (64)
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry take a case for Toodles' cousin in Hawaii, hoping to sneak in some rest and relaxation, but it's no vacation. The cousin's missing pineapple plant is only the starting place of the investigation as Tom and Jerry track down the culprit in this tropical environment.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (65)
programme.desc: Tom is chasing the mice around the haunted house when midnight strikes, and he finds himself face-to-face with a green-faced beast who's just as surprised to encounter Tom. It's soon revealed to be Toodles, who's a good witch brewing magic beauty products. Although Tom is enchanted at first, things stop going smoothly when he helps with her potions.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (48)
programme.desc: Chased by a raging elephant, Grizzy and the Lemmings are ejected from the cabin and land on a small nearby promontory. One of the rodents finds himself seated upon a throne-shaped boulder. A ray of sunlight illuminates him, and the savannah animals bow down before the Lemming king! But as soon as he leaves his royal seat, his powers disappear. Grizzy grabs the opportunity to plop down on the throne.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (49)
programme.desc: Grizzy is brutally awakened by four Lemmings who are giving a grand percussion concert near the cabin, while the rest of the group dances to the rhythm. The grumpy bear puts an end to the festivities by propelling the Lemmings into the distance. When they land, they discover a magical djembe inside the trunk of a baobab tree. When the percussionists start playing again, the Lemmings and all the other wild animals are possessed by the demon of dance!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (50)
programme.desc: In the midst of a heat wave, Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the fridge. The rodents want to transform themselves into ice cubes to glide across their super curling ice slide, while Grizzy wishes merely to lie down inside the nice, cool appliance. After literally breaking the fridge in two, the Lemmings discover a container of refrigerant and create a new giant curling sheet in the savannah. But Grizzy has not given up the idea of resting in a cool spot!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (21)

Jon, Min, and Miguel go all out preparing a grand welcome party, eager to show their parents just how far they’ve come as Dino Explorers! But Ma and Pa Cassidy find the island overwhelming, until their kids show them the wonder and fun of everything new.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (22)
programme.desc: Ma carefully chisels the perfect gemstone from a cave wall, a sparkling treasure she plans to craft into a beautiful bracelet for Pa, to celebrate their anniversary! There's just one problem: Bo forgot the anniversary! To make it right, Pa enlists the kids' help to find a gift worthy of Ma's sparkle! Their idea? The rare Lava Lily, a flower said to bloom only at the peak of the island's volcano!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (23)
programme.desc: The nasty tennis player is big and angry and wants his ball back. The one Mr. Bean managed to throw on the roof of a house across the road. Paralysed with vertigo sixty feet up on a windowsill, he is eventually brought to earth by the helpful intervention of a neighbour’s pet gerbil.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (24)
programme.desc: Bean’s sweet tooth leads him to despair when he bites off a bit more than he can chew. He is tormented by the toothache from Hell - and embarks on a hilarious mission to pull out this menace. Bean’s DIY attempts fail to succeed, and he is left with no other choice but to visit the dreaded dentist. But can Bean brave the Dentist’s chair? Or will the dentist despair when faced with Bean’s antics?

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (9)

When he realizes that Baby Lemmings are talented rodents, he tries to convince them to help him with his mission. But he doesn't anticipate the creative spirit of the Baby Lemmings, who can't be satisfied with just cutting logs without having fun!

programme.desc: The baby lemmings are stunned to witness a collision between two partridges in flight. The impact causes a pile of feathers to fall in front of them, which they use to play at gliding. Baby Owl, meanwhile, is struggling to fly with her tiny wings, and envies the majestic partridges flying in the distance. When she sees the feathers the baby lemmings have collected, she thinks she'll be able to fly better if she takes them!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (5)
programme.desc: Baby Owl can't sleep without her little owl blankie. But she loses it because she's clumsy. When the baby lemmings discover it, they think it's so cool they decide to include it in their activities - it really is a good friend! In a panic, Baby Owl looks for her comforter and tries to get it back from the baby lemmings, but her clumsiness gives them the impression that she wants to harm the comforter! The baby lemmings decide to protect the comforter against all odds!

programme.title: Batwheels (17)
programme.desc: Redbird is convinced that nobody likes his eccentric dance moves, but when Toyman traps Robin behind a dance-themed gauntlet, it’s up to the rambunctious rally car to dance his way to victory.

programme.title: Batwheels (17)
programme.desc: Buff feels left out at a playdate with Snowy and Grundy, and he goes off on his own. But when Banebuggy shows up, Buff needs his friends more than ever!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (21)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is keen to own a brand new smart phone when he discovers all the wonderful things it can do. But after a trip to the mobile phone shop he is horrified at how much they cost and decides to build his own one. Bean’s phone may be bulky but it comes with a whole range of built in gadgets especially useful during a race to The Tower of London.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (22)
programme.desc: A confused Japanese tourist couple mistake Mr Bean’s house for a hotel and because of the language barrier it is difficult to explain otherwise. When the hapless holidaymakers offer to pay to stay Mr Bean and Mrs Wicket see a way of making some money and pretend their house is indeed a hotel. But it’s not long before the tourists start to smell a fish.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (35)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is off on a train trip but loses his ticket as he waves goodbye to Irma on the platform, so has to find ways of escaping the eagle-eyed ticket inspector. He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (36)
programme.desc: Mr Bean has cleared up the leaves in Mrs Wicket’s path using a leafblower, but can’t find anywhere to put the heap he’s created. So he uses the power tool to blow the pile of leaves in a neat bundle along the street to find somewhere to dump them. Things take a turn when he inadvertently manages to foil a bank robbery with his new toy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (37)
programme.desc: When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed - but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front - but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (1)
programme.desc: Inspired by a wildlife documentary on TV, Mr. Bean dusts off his camera and treks deep into the countryside in search of the perfect wildlife photograph. After two fruitless days of being the hunter, he is somewhat miffed to find himself the hunted.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (23)
programme.desc: The gang goes to Salem, Massachusetts for a historical festival, only to discover history repeating itself as a demon has been set loose on the town, summoned by a witch as revenge for the infamous 17th Century Salem Witch Trials.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (24)
programme.desc: Fred and the gang are called in to help with a mystery involving a figure from Fred's past, Professor Huh? Fred discovers Rose, with whom he learned mystery solving until they had a falling out, has also arrived with her gang.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (12)
programme.desc: As they fight over the last jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy and the Lemmings accidentally send it flying deep into the jungle. They both set out in search for the jar, but in a forest that dense, it’s an impossible mission. In a Mayan Temple, the Lemmings discover a magic bracelet that increases one’s sense of smell tenfold and use it to find the jar. Grizzy loses their trail, but finds some Mayan bracelets himself: one for eyesight and one for hearing.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (13)
programme.desc: Just as Grizzy is about to go to bed, he ousts the Lemmings who are holding a surprise party in the cabin. The Lemmings land in a Mayan Temple devoted to the moon. While toying with an ancestral console, the Lemmings set off a cosmic phenomenon that brings the moon, which is now the size of a disco ball, to the temple. In its aura, gravity becomes very weak. Enough to get rid of Grizzy and have a very original fiesta.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (14)
programme.desc: Grizzy does his best to get rid of the Lemmings and enjoy some peace and quiet in the cabin, but each time they come back with a new and even more-disturbing activity. When he sees some penguins marching in a perfectly disciplined line, Grizzy decides to teach the Lemmings how to behave in his presence. He locks himself up with them inside the garage, which has been transformed into an elementary school classroom.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (15)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight once again and cause an accident with Santa Claus’ sled. The Lemmings rush to the crash site and get their hands on Santa’s magic bag. While Grizzy is tidying up the cabin after their fight, he is baffled to see the Lemmings come back him, quiet and calm. The rodents break out into Christmas carols and prepare a delicious snack for Grizzy before slipping out again.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (16)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings do not agree on which program to watch on TV. Grizzy confiscates the remote-control device. He thinks he’s won the battle, but the Lemmings find another one at the research station. A furious combat begins until the adversaries realize that the research station device has a special button that controls objects.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (17)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a blast racing down the ice slope in competition with the stuffed Bear-Ranger and manage to win each time. Grizzy cannot stand seeing his avatar humiliated and he decides to enter the competition to help him. Their frenzied descent gets out of hand and everyone is propelled all the way to the hangar of the research station, where they discover an ultra-sophisticated racing game. The racecourse sprawls over the entire icefield via drones that project holographic elements.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (43)
programme.desc: When Mr. Bean's picnic sandwiches get eaten by pigeons, he heads to the supermarket to replace them. Only the parent and child parking bays are free, so he parks there and pretends that Teddy is a baby in a blanket, plonking him in a trolley. But once in the shop, he gets the trollies mixed up and ends up with a real baby! Can he switch the baby and Teddy back before he's found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (30)
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are at the cinema to see the three hour long “Romance In Paris”, which Mr Bean is not looking forward to. But when he sees that they are also showing an action movie - Zombie Aliens 3 - he finds a way to sneak out and into the other screen. But will he get past the usher, and what will happen when Irma notices?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (31)
programme.desc: When a TV show offers cash to film in haunted homes, Mr Bean invites a film crew over and rigs his flat up to make it as spooky as possible - wobbly picture frames on wires, eerie noises on a tape recorder and a good old-fashioned sheet for a ghost. But will the tricks be convincing enough to win Mr Bean the money?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (32)

Mr Bean turns his flat upside before spotting the bejewelled cat and gives chase. But when Mrs Wicket sees Mr Bean’s abandoned flat in a mess, she thinks her necklace has been stolen by a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (33)

Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (27)
programme.desc: Envious of all the attention his landlady is receiving because of a broken leg, Mr. Bean decides to 'break' his leg too. When he ends up in hospital under the care of the Matron from Hell he discovers there are some kinds of attention even he doesn't enjoy.

programme.title: Batwheels (14)
programme.desc: Gotham’s annual dog show is tonight, and Harley plans to compete for the prized “Best in Show” ribbon. Sensing she’s up to no good, Robin decides to enter rough-and-tumble Ace the Bat-Dog to keep an eye on the thieving trickster.

programme.title: Batwheels (19)
programme.desc: Clayface is back in town, and this time he may be too much, and too many, for the Batwheels to handle!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (15)
programme.desc: Redbird gushes about his favorite hero and driver - Robin - as he shows off their action-packed adventures and gadgets in his own personal vlog.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (24)
programme.desc: Daphne agrees to watch her friend's kid, Wayne, and convinces Fred to take a night off from mysteries to go to the boardwalk amusement park. Unbeknownst to her, though, the park is being haunted by a fiendish clown, Madcap.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (25)
programme.desc: The gang goes on a camping trip, although they can't really agree on why. Fred's desire for the gang to get in touch with their natural instincts and hones their mystery skills, turns into on-the-job training as Viking Ghosts attack and attempt to drive them away - or worse.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (31)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have adopted a small exotic fish that’s lively and affectionate and have fun decorating its aquarium. Jealous, Grizzy finds a fish too, but his is expressionless and indifferent to the bear’s efforts to communicate. Grizzy plots to exchange the two fish behind the Lemmings' backs. He puts the affectionate fish in an even bigger aquarium with a pharaonic decor and locks the lid. But the Lemmings have no intention of leaving their friend to Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (32)
programme.desc: The Lemmings use all the cans and tins they can get their hands on to build a beach slide. Grizzy, annoyed at not finding his tinned fish to prepare his meal tray, recovers them from the Lemmings. In their struggle, Grizzy loses his badge! Grizzy and the Lemmings now fight over a valuable metal detector that each party needs to accomplish their goal: build a slide or find the beloved badge.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (33)
programme.desc: The Lemmings take a liking to an endangered crab on the beach and decide to shelter it from a seagull who is using its shell to open coconuts. They bring it home to a disgruntled Grizzy, who wants to watch TV in peace while snacking on Cheetos. When the Lemmings turn into full-fledged crab rescuers, the house is soon overrun with crustaceans. Grizzy decides to use the seagull to get rid of the crabs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (49)
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the fondness of his beloved she-bear for meditation. To seduce her, he sets out to prove to her that he too can attain the Zen attitude. This demands practice, of course, but it especially demands lots of willpower and concentration to get rid of the rowdy Lemmings without losing one's temper.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (50)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a super-secret Canadian Army prototype which resembles a simple computer keyboard. It has only several command keys: select, cut and paste, and delete, but the keys act directly on surrounding elements... as well as on living beings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (51)
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a blast with a bowling game they found in the Ranger's storeroom. Grizzy hastens to destroy the pins to ensure his peace and quiet. But the Lemmings discover a remote-control device that can modify the ball's weight. By setting it on maximum, the ball could knock over much more than pins: furniture, a bear and even a log cabin!

programme.title: Lamput (35)
programme.desc: Lamput shows kindness to a nearby spider - and in the process makes a valuable ally. Good thing, too, because the mozzies around here are diabolical.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (23)
programme.desc: Deep in the jungle, chaos erupts when a pair of raptors ambush the kids. But before the predators can strike, Uncle Jack and Pa swoop in, tackling the dinos with daring moves and perfect timing! As the brothers trade grins and playful jabs, it’s clear this isn’t just teamwork, it’s a competition! This kickstarts the ultimate race, as the brothers compete to get to the top of the volcano first.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (24)
programme.desc: It’s Ma and Pa’s last day on Dino Island, and the Ranchers are determined to make it perfect! So, they each pick one big adventure—three epic Cassidy-style activities to send their parents off in unforgettable fashion! However, each activity ends in ultimate failure and the kids are disappointed- until they are reminded by their parents that any day spent together is the perfect day.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (21)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is keen to own a brand new smart phone when he discovers all the wonderful things it can do. But after a trip to the mobile phone shop he is horrified at how much they cost and decides to build his own one. Bean’s phone may be bulky but it comes with a whole range of built in gadgets especially useful during a race to The Tower of London.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (22)
programme.desc: A confused Japanese tourist couple mistake Mr Bean’s house for a hotel and because of the language barrier it is difficult to explain otherwise. When the hapless holidaymakers offer to pay to stay Mr Bean and Mrs Wicket see a way of making some money and pretend their house is indeed a hotel. But it’s not long before the tourists start to smell a fish.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (23)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is on a photography jaunt in the countryside snapping the normal everyday wildlife - a fox a bird a dinosaur! A DINOSAUR?!! Mr Bean is terrified until he realises what fame and fortune it could bring him. Does he get the photograph of a lifetime or is the situation not quite as it seems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (30)
programme.desc: When nursing an injured magpie in his room, Mr. Bean learns something the rest of us already know: magpies can’t help stealing anything that sparkles. When the police arrive to investigate the theft of his landlady’s jewellery, it’s not just Mr. Bean that needs to take flight.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (30)
programme.desc: Baby Lynx is desperately looking for a worthy opponent to race against. When she sees the Baby Lemmings chasing an apple rolling down a slope, she wants to race against them. But in reality, they are really bad at it! Baby Lynx decides to train the Baby Lemmings in the hope of having real opponents.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (31)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that a little water and a little sunlight can make seeds grow. They're amazed. Baby Lynx would like to join in the gardening, but her eagerness means she ruins the fragile little sprout. The Baby Lemmings decide to do a little vegetable garden of their own. Annoyed, Baby Lynx decides to challenge them to a competition for the most beautiful garden!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (18)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that they can make blue paint by crushing berries and start covering the forest with funny little drawings of their own invention. When the Baby Lynx sees this, she gets in on the act and decides to cover the forest with drawings in her own colour, red. A natural graffiti battle ensues between her and the baby lemmings.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (1)
programme.desc: Squeaks finds himself up against a small group of ninjas. Bugs has to come to the rescue.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (2)
programme.desc: Yosemite Sam hopes to make a quick escape from a bank heist and is surprised to discover Bugs as his getaway driver.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (2)
programme.desc: Bugs finds himself off the beaten path with Bigfoot when they realize the Hazmats are close on their tails. Bugs must do everything he can to protect Bigfoot while not becoming collateral damage himself.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes (3)
programme.desc: Sir Littlechin the Knight is on a quest to capture a dragon but not if Bugs has anything to do with it.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (5)
programme.desc: After a Giant Houndbeast attacks an elite dog show, the gang goes undercover and enters Scooby in the show in order to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (6)
programme.desc: Unhappy about a mystery-free, three-day, cross-country train trip with the gang, Fred is pleasantly surprised to discover a monster mystery on board. He's less pleasantly surprised however, when that mystery is interrupted by a second mystery, then a third, then a fourth…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (23)
programme.desc: The nasty tennis player is big and angry and wants his ball back. The one Mr. Bean managed to throw on the roof of a house across the road. Paralysed with vertigo sixty feet up on a windowsill, he is eventually brought to earth by the helpful intervention of a neighbour’s pet gerbil.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (10)
programme.desc: Mr Bean has forgotten he's supposed to be cooking dinner for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. He dashes to the supermarket to buy some groceries but why buy food when you can win an entire trolley full in an All You Can Eat Competition? But Mr Bean has some stiff competition - no one can eat one of Mr Magg’s pies quicker than Mr Maggs himself. Mr Bean has to think fast to win. But after all that eating will Bean still be in the mood to cook a romantic meal?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (74)
programme.desc: Tom, Jerry and Tuffy have a run-in with a moving suit of armor. The knight scares Tom away, but Jerry makes a brave stand because he thinks the knight is Tom in disguise. Jerry eventually trips the suit of armor and finds out it's inhabited by three kittens. Relieved at first, the pets soon realize that battling one haunted knight is nothing compared to battling three real-life kittens.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (75)
programme.desc: Jerry's high-born cousin Count DaCalories—a haughty city mouse—visits the estate. At first, he acts sleek and refined, but soon he can't resist pigging out and going on multiple kitchen raids. As his paunch grows, it becomes more and more difficult for him to outrun Tom and stay out of sight of the Duchess's visitor.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (76)
programme.desc: In Catsylvania, the peasant mice oompah band plays onstage at the auditorium. As the bandleader's lovely daughter, Gretta, hits a high note in her rousing song, Tom—in a mask and hood—swings in on a rope and abducts her. Van Mouseling and the peasant band chase him through the rafters and backstage, but Tom escapes with his captive to a subterranean lair. Will the mice manage to free Gretta?

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (6)
programme.desc: Jerry is raiding the fridge but gets caught by Tom. Tom tries to get the food back, but Jerry and Tuffy fight back by throwing food at Tom. Jerry accidentally throws Tuffy at Tom and has to rescue him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (3)
programme.desc: Grizzy gets rid of the Lemmings by crushing them with one of the ranger's heavy trunks, which he immediately clears out of the cabin, his enemies stuck to it like stickers. What he doesn't know, is that the trunk contains a multifunction drone, complete with joystick and virtual reality headset, which enables "embedded" piloting. Thanks to this cutting-edge technology, the Lemmings decide to regain control of the situation!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (4)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a strange pond in an American Indian grotto that has the power to rejuvenate anyone who dips in it. They spray a bit of the water of youth onto Grizzy and he instantly turns into a harmless cub they can easily rid themselves of. But the effects of the waters are only temporary.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (5)
programme.desc: Before taking a nap, Grizzy locks the food cupboard to prevent the Lemmings from getting into it. And to be sure they cannot force the lock, Grizzy throws all the house tools into the ravine. The Lemmings find a crate of mini building-blocks which enables them to build a hammer... and any other object they wish!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (6)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings happen on a native American Indian burial place under the ranger's cabin. When they accidentally activate a magic disk representing the earth, they are sent back in time to the prehistoric era...

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (7)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a phial containing a love potion: anyone who drinks it immediately falls in love with the first creature he sees. Grizzy already imagines himself becoming irresistible in the eyes of his beloved she-bear. But that is without taking into account the Lemmings... clumsiness, and their rodeo caribou drinking the magic potion.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (8)
programme.desc: The Lemmings notice that Grizzy moves away from the jar of chocolate spread whenever he chases the fly buzzing around him. But the insect can never hold out long enough for the Lemmings to swipe the jar before being knocked out. They decide to give the fly intensive sports training.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (25)
programme.desc: Kid Kazoom and Multy have to enter an active volcano to retrieve a new Kazoom fragment, again...

programme.title: Batwheels (11)
programme.desc: Redbird gets excited when he learns that Batman and Robin are taking him and Bam for a drive up the coast! But when the Joker and his van Prank show up unexpectedly and ruin Redbird’s beach day plans, Bam helps him realize that even though things didn’t go exactly as planned, they still had a great day!

programme.title: Batwheels (12)
programme.desc: After the Joker floods the Batcave, the Batwheels evacuate and relocate to a nearby parking garage. As they adapt to their temporary home, they learn important lessons about family and making the most of what you have.

programme.title: Batwheels (13)
programme.desc: When Batman refuses to engage Joker in a race, Prank goads Bam into a rematch. Can Bam learn to not give in to the bully's dares and take the high road?

programme.title: Batwheels (14)
programme.desc: After struggling to solve a riddle from Riddler's helicopter Quizz, Redbird must learn to speak up and share his ideas with the Batwheels if they hope to figure out the villain's true scheme.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (2)
programme.desc: It’s Taz’s birthday, so The Looney Builders build him a huge ice cream sundae. Porky worries about making a mistake and delays the build causing the ice cream to start to melt.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (3)
programme.desc: The Looney Builders race against the clock to build Cecil Turtle a new racetrack. Daffy gets caught up in his own desire to race and changes part of the build.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (4)
programme.desc: George P. Mandrake hires The Looney Builders to build a T. Rex fossil. It’s Tweety’s job to place the bones with his crane, but his fear of the big dino affects his ability to get the job done.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders (5)
programme.desc: Pauleen Penguin hires The Looney Builders to build her a home in Looneyburg. Lola soon discovers they got the design wrong and the crew has to make adjustments.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time (6)
programme.desc: Tweety Bird uses his crane to lift stuff in this music video as he helps his crew get the job done.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (28)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is initially charmed when a seemingly cute seagull turns up on his windowsill. Bean feeds the gull and invites the bird inside. But it’s not long before the seagull in the flat turns out to be a cuckoo in the nest taking over Bean’s home - eating all his food controlling the TV and sleeping in his bed. Bean starts to regret taking on a new best friend in place of good old reliable Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (29)
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees a new toy car in the window of the local department store Havlotts and decides he must have it. But on the way to the toy department Mr Bean gets stuck in the lift. He tries his best to entertain his fellow passengers but they aren’t very appreciative. How can Mr Bean resolve the situation and get the toy he so desperately wants?
